# API reference

The read API is a single FastAPI application (`src/radar/api.py`) that also
serves the built React bundle from the same origin. 55 endpoints.

**Generated by `docs/build_reference.py`** from the running application, so it
cannot drift from the code.

## Conventions

**Reads are `GET` and never write.** The one deliberate exception is that a
missing *derived* artefact which is pure arithmetic — the competitor join, a
competitive assessment — is computed on first read rather than making the caller
press a button for a number the system could have worked out itself. Anything
that costs a model call is a `POST`.

**`POST` means "spend something".** Description, brief, competitor comparison and
generation are all synchronous, because each is one model call and the caller is
a person who just pressed a button. A background job would need a status
endpoint to tell them the same thing.

**Filters repeat their key.** `?vertical=manufacturing&vertical=energy` — FastAPI
reads repeated keys as a list.

**Unknown `/api` paths do not 404.** The catch-all serves the app shell so a
client-side route survives a reload. The cost is that an `/api` path the *server*
does not know answers `200 text/html`, which the frontend detects and reports as
"the running server is older than the bundle it is serving" — the usual cause.

## One topic

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}` | Topic detail with the full score decomposition (NFR-01, NFR-02, NFR-03). |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/assessment` | §4.10 model C — each role rates its own axis. |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/brief` | Whether a brief exists, when it was made and whether it has gone stale. |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/brief` | Build the PDF brief, generating its inputs if they are missing. |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/brief.pdf` | The PDF itself. |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/competition` | Named competitors and the computed intensity level (§4.3.3). |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/competition` |  |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/competitor-analysis` | What each competitor on this topic is doing, and how Orange differentiates. |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/competitor-analysis` | Write the comparison for one topic. One model call, synchronous. |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/description` | The generated long-form description, or 404 if none exists yet. |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/description` | Generate (or regenerate) the description for one topic. |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/evidence-timeline` | Signal accretion over time — momentum made visible (§4.6, §4.4.5). |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/history` | Score trajectory with the weight-set comparability warning (FR-20, §4.6). |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/market-size` | Every stored estimate for a topic, factor by factor (§4.3.4). |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/market-size` | Recompute from the reference data currently in the store. |
| `POST` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/stage` | Advance, park or reject a topic in the stage gate (§4.10 model A). |
| `GET` | `/api/topics/{topic_id}/transitions` |  |

## Competitors

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/competitors` | The register with its profiling status — including who refused to be read. |
| `GET` | `/api/competitors/{competitor_id}` | One competitor's profile, with the pages every claim was taken from. |

## The Planner

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/planner/meta` | Everything the plan form needs: the assumption set, and what is plannable. |
| `GET` | `/api/planner/plans` | Stored plans, most recent first, with their headline figures. |
| `POST` | `/api/planner/plans` | Select, schedule and project. Arithmetic only — no model call, so it is fast. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}` | Discard a plan. Its selections go with it; the exported PDF is left on disk. |
| `GET` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}` | One plan in full: inputs, selections, projection, capacity, flags, narrative. |
| `POST` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}/narrative` | Write the business plan. One model call, and it may not introduce a number. |
| `GET` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}/report` | Whether an exported PDF exists for this plan, and whether it is current. |
| `POST` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}/report` | Render the whole plan — inputs, projection, spaces, narrative, assumptions. |
| `GET` | `/api/planner/plans/{plan_id}/report.pdf` | The document itself, inline so the Planner can embed it in the browser. |

## Generation

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/generate` | Start a constrained generation run (background; poll the job). |
| `POST` | `/api/generate/brief` | Generate ONE opportunity space from a written description. |
| `GET` | `/api/generate/jobs` | Recent runs, newest first — so a page reload does not lose the record. |
| `GET` | `/api/generate/matching` | The opportunity spaces that ALREADY meet the criteria a run would use. |
| `GET` | `/api/generate/options` | What the Generate screen can offer, and whether a run is possible now. |
| `GET` | `/api/generate/{job_id}` |  |
| `POST` | `/api/generate/{job_id}/cancel` | Stop after the work in flight. |

## Errors

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `404` | No such topic, competitor or artefact. |
| `409` | Well-formed, but the precondition is absent — asking for a competitor comparison on a space with no competitive assessment, for instance. |
| `503` | The serving instance could not open its database. It starts and says so rather than crash-looping (see `bootstrap.py`). |
